newsitem.title: USA: Waxman Industries unit sells division.
newsitem.headline: Waxman Industries unit sells division.

text.p: Waxman Industries Inc said on Wednesday its WOC Inc indirect subsidiary sold all the assets of its LeRan Gas Products division to affiliate Barnett Inc for $4.0 million in cash and stock.
Subject to post-closing adjustments, the transaction consists of $3.4 million in cash, and $600,000 in stock, Waxman vice president Mark Wester told Reuters.
Waxman owns 44.5 percent of Barnett, it said in the statement. Waxman Industries Inc supplies do-it-yourself plumbing, electrical and hardware items in the United States.
Waxman shares were up 1/8 to 4-7/8 at midday.
